Merger Consideration components include: per-share cash of $29.00 for Company Common Stock (the Merger Consideration). No stock exchange ratio or CVRs are indicated. Additional cash consideration is payable for Company stock-based awards: Company Stock Options are cashed out in cash based on the Merger Consideration, and if the exercise price is equal to or greater than the Merger Consideration such options are cancelled (and do not receive payment). The issuer contemplates cash-out for other awards (RSUs, PSUs, RSAs, SSPAs) as described in Section 2.06, though the explicit numeric mechanics for those awards are not reproduced here.
No exchange ratio; cash-based consideration: $29.00 per share.
